def.name: Archery
def.flavorLine: Archery is older than the LINK. That's not a weakness.
def.description: The ability to use bows, crossbows, slings, and slingshots effectively.
covers: Targeted shots with bows or slings
Rapid reloads and sustained ranged attacks
Use of mechanical aids such as compound bows

def.name: Beam Weapons
def.flavorLine: Energy doesn’t care about cover. Neither does the person holding it.
def.description: The ability to operate weapons that fire energy, including continuous beams or pulsed energy projectiles.
covers: Attacking with Laser rifles and plasma pistols
Maintaining aim and control under recoil or energy discharge
notes: Does not include magical energy or supernatural powers.

def.name: Combat Sense
def.flavorLine: The half-second between noticing and reacting is where most people die.
def.description: The ability to perceive and react to threats in combat. Used to determine initiative and situational awareness.
covers: Reacting to ambushes or sudden attacks

def.name: Dodge
def.flavorLine: Everyone thinks they can dodge. They're right, once.
def.description: The ability to avoid attacks or evade damage from traps and environmental hazards.

def.name: Handguns
def.flavorLine: Everyone in NYTE City has one. Not everyone knows what to do after the first shot.
def.description: The ability to use semi-automatic, single-handed firearms, including pistols, revolvers, and small-caliber wrist-mounted weapons.

def.name: Heavy Weapons
def.flavorLine: The conversation’s already over. This is the punctuation.
def.description: The ability to operate large-caliber and mounted weapons, including vehicle-mounted guns, grenade launchers, and rocket launchers.
covers: Using mounted or vehicle-based weapon systems

picks.label: Martial Arts style
picks.note: Up to two at creation. More may be trained later in play (Decision 56).

def.name: Martial Arts
def.flavorLine: A weapon can be taken. A form can't.
def.description: The ability to fight unarmed or with specialized techniques, including strikes, holds, and maneuvers.
covers: Use of specialized weapons integral to a Martial Art
notes: Choose up to two Martial Arts styles at creation. You may train additional styles later in play.
Each style trained grants its own bonus.

styles.name: Custom Style
styles.bonus: Talk with GM to determine bonus

def.name: Melee
def.flavorLine: When the gun jams, the knife doesn't.
def.description: The ability to use handheld, improvised, and thrown weapons effectively, including knives, clubs, chair legs, shuriken, grenades, and similar items. Also used when taking the Parry action.

def.name: Rifles
def.flavorLine: Distance is a luxury. Patience is a skill.
def.description: The ability to operate rifles, including urban combat rifles, shotguns, and sniper rifles.

def.name: SMGs
def.flavorLine: Close. Fast. Loud. In that order.
def.description: The ability to operate submachine guns, covering weapons capable of burst or full-automatic fire.
covers: Targeting multiple opponents in close to mid-range

def.name: Tactics
def.flavorLine: Positioning wins fights. Everything else just decides how long they take.
def.description: Applied understanding of combat strategy and positioning.
notes: Awareness identifies the situation; Tactics determines how to act on it.
The GM may provide guidance based on available information.

def.name: Basic Tech
def.flavorLine: Everything in NYTE City is held together by someone who knows which wire not to pull.
def.description: General knowledge and practical use of mechanical, vehicular, and common technologies.
covers: Repair and maintenance of everyday devices

def.name: Cybernetics
def.flavorLine: The body is hardware. Cybernetics is the warranty work.
def.description: Knowledge and manipulation of cybernetic implants, limbs, and integrated systems.
covers: Installation, removal, and modification of cyberware

def.name: Demolitions
def.flavorLine: The placement is everything. The rest is just timing.
def.description: The creation, placement, and disarming of explosive devices.
covers: Plastic explosives, IEDs, and industrial explosives
notes: Does not include grenade or rocket launchers (see Heavy Weapons Skill)

def.name: Engineering
def.flavorLine: Basic Tech fixes what’s broken. Engineering decides what gets built next.
def.description: Advanced technical expertise in the design and manipulation of complex systems.
covers: Designing, modifying, or improving complex devices

def.name: Interface
def.flavorLine: NYTE City has a second skin. Most people live on the surface.
def.description: Direct interaction with the LINK through a tactile or neural interface.

def.name: Medical
def.flavorLine: Field medicine isn't about saving lives. It's about buying time.
def.description: Training in diagnosing and treating injuries and illnesses.
covers: Use of medical tools and supplies
Treatment of disease, toxins, and physical harm

def.name: Programming
def.flavorLine: Code doesn't argue. It does exactly what you wrote, including the mistakes.
def.description: The creation and modification of software systems.

def.name: Robotics
def.flavorLine: They don’t get tired. They don’t get scared. Someone still has to tell them what to do.
def.description: Knowledge of robotic systems combining mechanics, electronics, and software.
covers: Working with autonomous (Drones) and semi-autonomous machines

def.name: Security
def.flavorLine: Every security system was designed by someone. That someone had assumptions.
def.description: Understanding and exploitation of security measures.
covers: Physical security layouts and guard procedures

def.name: Acrobatics
def.flavorLine: Falling is easy. Falling and landing somewhere useful takes practice.
def.description: Physical agility, balance, and coordination.

def.name: Athletics
def.flavorLine: NYTE City is vertical, hostile, and fast. Athletics is the tax you pay to move through it.
def.description: Physical strength, stamina, and gross motor capability.

def.name: Awareness
def.flavorLine: What you don't notice doesn't care.
def.description: Perceptiveness and attention to detail.
covers: Noticing subtle environmental or behavioral cues

marks.text: +5 when identifying or detecting magical effects within meters equal to your WILL
marks.whenText: when identifying or detecting magical effects within meters equal to your WILL

def.name: Deception
def.flavorLine: Everyone's working with a version of the truth. Deception is authoring theirs.
def.description: The ability to mislead, misdirect, or lie to influence others' perceptions.
covers: Lying, bluffing, and maintaining cover stories
Creating false impressions or misleading narratives
notes: Outcomes reflect the degree of confusion, doubt, or misperception, not forced actions
Can be opposed by the target’s Deception skill

def.name: Disguise
def.flavorLine: The face you were born with is one option.
def.description: The ability to convincingly appear as another person.

def.name: Intimidation
def.flavorLine: Not everyone needs to be convinced. Some people just need to understand the cost.
def.description: The ability to influence others through fear, threat, or presence.
covers: Creating hesitation, uncertainty, or caution in others
Using posture, tone, or reputation to assert dominance
Reading and exploiting others’ fear responses
notes: Outcomes reflect increased leverage, temporary compliance, or hesitation, not forced actions
Can be opposed by the target’s Intimidation skill

def.name: Intuition
def.flavorLine: By the time you can explain it, it's already too late to act on it.
def.description: Instinctive understanding of people and situations.

def.name: Investigation
def.flavorLine: Everything leaves a trace. Investigation is knowing which ones matter.
def.description: Systematic gathering and analysis of information.

def.name: Occult Lore
def.flavorLine: Most people are happier not knowing. Most people also don't survive long enough for it to matter.
def.description: Knowledge of supernatural phenomena and hidden truths.
covers: Knowledge of Monsters and otherworldly entities

def.name: Persuasion
def.flavorLine: People do what they want to do. Persuasion is making them want to do something else.
def.description: The ability to influence others through reasoned argument, negotiation, or appeal.
covers: Convincing others to consider your point of view
Shaping decisions, opinions, or cooperation through dialogue
Anticipating objections and countering them effectively
notes: Outcomes reflect increased willingness, openness, or temporary cooperation, not forced actions
Can be opposed by the target’s Persuasion skill

def.name: Pilot
def.flavorLine: The vehicle does what physics allows. The pilot decides what that means.
def.description: The ability to operate any vehicle, mech, or steerable machine at speed and under pressure.
covers: Maneuvering any steerable vehicle, including Rigs

def.name: Seduction
def.flavorLine: The most dangerous thing in the room is rarely armed.
def.description: The ability to influence others through charm, allure, and personal presence.
covers: Creating attraction or interest that can sway choices
Leveraging appearance, personality, or body language
Reading social cues and emotional responses
notes: Outcomes reflect temporary influence, attention, or willingness, not forced actions
Can be opposed by the target’s Seduction skill

def.name: Stealth
def.flavorLine: Presence is a choice. So is absence.
def.description: Avoiding detection through concealment and quiet movement.
covers: Evading visual, auditory, or sensor-based detection

def.name: Streetwise
def.flavorLine: Every city has an official map. NYTE City has another one underneath.
def.description: Knowledge of the criminal and underground landscape of NYTE City.
covers: Pawn shops, fixers, and safe houses
The Labyrinth and other shadow networks

def.name: Survival
def.flavorLine: Comfort is a city concept. Survival is what's left when the city isn't.
def.description: Endurance and self-sufficiency in hostile environments.

def.name: Tracking
def.flavorLine: In NYTE City, nothing disappears. It just moves.
def.description: Following trails to locate a target.
covers: Physical tracking of people or creatures
Interpreting signs, patterns, and residual evidence

def.name: Occult Lore
def.flavorLine: Most people are happier not knowing. Most people also don't survive long enough for it to matter.
def.description: Knowledge of supernatural phenomena and hidden truths.
covers: Knowledge of Monsters and otherworldly entities

def.name: Persuasion

Shaping decisions, opinions, or cooperation through dialogue

notes: Outcomes reflect increased willingness, openness, or temporary cooperation, not forced actions
Can be opposed by the target’s Persuasion skill

def.name: Pilot
def.flavorLine: The vehicle does what physics allows. The pilot decides what that means.
def.description: The ability to operate any vehicle, mech, or steerable machine at speed and under pressure.
covers: Maneuvering any steerable vehicle, including Rigs

def.name: Seduction
def.flavorLine: The most dangerous thing in the room is rarely armed.
def.description: The ability to influence others through charm, allure, and personal presence.

Leveraging appearance, personality, or body language
Reading social cues and emotional responses
notes: Outcomes reflect temporary influence, attention, or willingness, not forced actions
Can be opposed by the target’s Seduction skill

def.name: Stealth
def.flavorLine: Presence is a choice. So is absence.
def.description: Avoiding detection through concealment and quiet movement.
covers: Evading visual, auditory, or sensor-based detection

def.name: Streetwise
def.flavorLine: Every city has an official map. NYTE City has another one underneath.
def.description: Knowledge of the criminal and underground landscape of NYTE City.
covers: Pawn shops, fixers, and safe houses
The Labyrinth and other shadow networks

def.name: Survival
def.flavorLine: Comfort is a city concept. Survival is what's left when the city isn't.
def.description: Endurance and self-sufficiency in hostile environments.

def.name: Tracking
def.flavorLine: In NYTE City, nothing disappears. It just moves.
def.description: Following trails to locate a target.
covers: Physical tracking of people or creatures
Interpreting signs, patterns, and residual evidence

def.name: Archery
def.flavorLine: Archery is older than the LINK. That's not a weakness.

Rapid reloads and sustained ranged attacks

def.name: Beam Weapons

def.name: Combat Sense
def.flavorLine: The half-second between noticing and reacting is where most people die.

def.name: Dodge
def.flavorLine: Everyone thinks they can dodge. They're right, once.
def.description: The ability to avoid attacks or evade damage from traps and environmental hazards.

def.name: Handguns

def.name: Heavy Weapons
def.flavorLine: The conversation’s already over. This is the punctuation.

covers: Using mounted or vehicle-based weapon systems

def.flavorLine: A weapon can be taken. A form can't.

styles.name: Custom Style
styles.bonus: Talk with GM to determine bonus

def.name: Melee
def.flavorLine: When the gun jams, the knife doesn't.

def.name: Rifles
def.flavorLine: Distance is a luxury. Patience is a skill.
def.description: The ability to operate rifles, including urban combat rifles, shotguns, and sniper rifles.

def.name: SMGs
def.flavorLine: Close. Fast. Loud. In that order.
def.description: The ability to operate submachine guns, covering weapons capable of burst or full-automatic fire.
covers: Targeting multiple opponents in close to mid-range

def.name: Tactics
def.flavorLine: Positioning wins fights. Everything else just decides how long they take.
def.description: Applied understanding of combat strategy and positioning.
notes: Awareness identifies the situation; Tactics determines how to act on it.

def.name: Basic Tech

def.description: The ability to operate any vehicle, mech, or steerable machine at speed and under pressure.
covers: Maneuvering any steerable vehicle, including Rigs

def.name: Seduction
def.flavorLine: The most dangerous thing in the room is rarely armed.
def.description: The ability to influence others through charm, allure, and personal presence.
covers: Creating attraction or interest that can sway choices
Leveraging appearance, personality, or body language
Reading social cues and emotional responses
notes: Outcomes reflect temporary influence, attention, or willingness, not forced actions
Can be opposed by the target’s Seduction skill

def.name: Stealth
def.flavorLine: Presence is a choice. So is absence.
def.description: Avoiding detection through concealment and quiet movement.
covers: Evading visual, auditory, or sensor-based detection

def.name: Streetwise
def.flavorLine: Every city has an official map. NYTE City has another one underneath.
def.description: Knowledge of the criminal and underground landscape of NYTE City.
covers: Pawn shops, fixers, and safe houses
The Labyrinth and other shadow networks

def.name: Survival
def.flavorLine: Comfort is a city concept. Survival is what's left when the city isn't.
def.description: Endurance and self-sufficiency in hostile environments.

def.name: Tracking
def.flavorLine: In NYTE City, nothing disappears. It just moves.
def.description: Following trails to locate a target.
covers: Physical tracking of people or creatures
Interpreting signs, patterns, and residual evidence
